capabilities: Read PDFs page-by-page with screen-sized stops for tall pages on mobile landscape
Resume last page and in-page position, merging per-device records from a synced vault folder
Record focused reading sessions and show daily, weekly, and monthly logs with charts
Settle daily reading totals into a linked book note's ## log section
Read EPUBs with adjustable typography, two-column layout, and CFI-based resume positions
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese). Relies on Obsidian's internal PDF.js viewer interface, so Obsidian updates may require a compatibility fix; the README advises retesting after updates. Optional ~25 MB Noto Serif CJK SC font downloads from GitHub. Works offline with no accounts or telemetry; distributed via BRAT or manual installation.
intentEvidence: It works in Obsidian's existing PDF tab rather than importing or rewriting the PDF.
problem: Obsidian's PDF viewer scrolls continuously and does not resume reading position across devices or track reading time, especially awkward for mobile landscape reading.

relations.evidence: The built-in EPUB reader uses EPUB.js for single-screen pagination

summary: PDF and EPUB reader that shows one page or screen at a time, with resume positions, bookmarks, and reading-time logs stored in the vault.
